source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current LoadMessage checks aDisplayConsumer before reading its browsing context and active state. Headless consumers such as the lock test pass null. The mark-read/peek decision also accounts for the automatic-marking preference, delayed marking and the explicit markRead=false URI option. Cache availability is recorded separately. Guarding this optional consumer preserves non-UI service calls; it does not establish that every downstream listener is optional.
title: Guard document-shell decisions when the message consumer is headless
